description: Essential TOEIC terms focusing on financial calculations, recruitment, professional qualities, and business operations.

nouns.meaning: quán ăn tự phục vụ, nhà ăn
nouns.example: Most employees have lunch in the company cafeteria to save time.
According to our calculations, the project will be profitable by next year.
You are allowed to use a basic calculator during the accounting exam.
The marketing campaign resulted in a 15% increase in brand awareness.

nouns.meaning: sự xóa bỏ, sự hủy bỏ
nouns.example: The hotel has a 24-hour cancellation policy for all reservations.
The board is currently reviewing his candidacy for the position of Vice President.
We are looking for a candidate with at least five years of experience in sales.
The conference hall has a seating capacity of 500 people.
The startup is looking for extra capital to expand its operations overseas.
He spent most of his career working for international non-profit organizations.
Customers receive a 5% discount if they pay in cash.
The cashier handed me the receipt and wished me a nice day.
The heavy rain was the main cause of the flight delays.
The company held a celebration to mark its 20th anniversary.
You will receive a certificate of completion after finishing the training course.
Professional certification can help improve your chances of getting promoted.
They are planning to open a new chain of coffee shops across the city.
Shopping at a chain store ensures consistent quality and pricing.
Please take a chair and wait for the manager in the lobby.
The chairperson called the meeting to order at 9:00 AM.
Reliability is a key characteristic we look for in our suppliers.
There is no extra charge for using the hotel's fitness center.

adjectives.example: A careless mistake in the financial report caused a lot of confusion.
Investors are very cautious about putting money into the new tech startup.

verbs.example: We need to calculate the total shipping costs before sending the invoice.
The meeting was canceled because the director had an urgent matter to attend to.
The technical glitch might cause some temporary disruptions to the website.
The team went out to dinner to celebrate winning the new contract.
High quality and durability characterize all products from this brand.
The consultant decided to charge a flat fee for the entire project.
